result.reason: The additions substantively provide six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, a machine-readable data return within 30 days, and deletion certification. However, the chapeau applies only “Upon termination,” so references in the new subclauses to “termination or expiration” do not clearly create rights upon expiry. In addition, existing subsection (iv) permits Kubient to destroy Customer Data immediately as Confidential Information, which should be expressly subordinated to the new return-and-deletion process. The redline is otherwise targeted and preserves unrelated commercial terms, but these operative ambiguities prevent it from fully reaching the preferred position.
